user.title: Orphan Entities
user.description: Lists the entities that their integration no longer provides, so that you can remove them in bulk.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between two scans. The entity registry is also scanned a few seconds after it changes.
data_description.grace_period: Minutes after Home Assistant has started before the first scan, while the integrations set up their entities.
data_description.stale_hours: Hours an entity still provided by its integration must have been unavailable (or unknown) to be listed. 0 lists only the entities no longer provided.
data_description.include_unknown: Also list the entities unknown for that long. Buttons, scenes and events, unknown by design, are never listed.
data_description.ignored_integrations: Integrations whose entities are never listed. Type a domain to add one that isn't listed.
data_description.ignored_entities: Entities never listed (entity IDs). The card adds them here with its Ignore button.

scan.name: Scan for orphaned entities
scan.description: Scans the entity registry for the entities their integration no longer provides.

remove.name: Remove orphaned entities
remove.description: Removes entities listed by the last scan from the entity registry.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Entity IDs to remove. Each one must be in the list of orphaned entities.

ignore.name: Ignore entities
ignore.description: Adds entities to the ignored entities: they are no longer listed.

starting.message: Home Assistant is still starting: the first scan runs once the grace period is over.

too_many.message: At most {max} entities at a time.

not_orphan.message: Not in the list of orphaned entities: {entities}. Scan again and retry.
